defects.summary: Deviation 50 says the guard is called inside `if (launch.Confinement is LaunchConfinement.Planned)` in Build, but Build calls MustCarryNoFlag every time and the Planned test is inside the guard; the effect is the same, but the quoted call site is wrong.

The skeleton section records a past step that is no longer true ('placeholders that throw', 'no test has been run red or green yet') and names reviews R1/R2 that the plan does not explain, so the deviations list contains process notes.

The Kimi arm has a block body with `return` and a fully qualified `new Confinement.Planned`, while its siblings (Vibe, Antigravity) use an expression body with target-typed `new` and a comment that `web` never reaches the arm.
The new AKimiConsultant() helper copies the Kimi consultant construction that already exists in Adapters(), when the two could share it.
S5.6.6 tests only a plan with Flags; the guard also refuses Leading and AddDirs, and no test covers those two.

S5.5.1 checks only that `--cwd` contains `own\tree`, not that it is under the check's scratch; it starts the unlink recorder but never asserts on it; and S5.5.2's exit-70 arm does not assert that the check failed.

summary: E5.5 and E5.6 are delivered to spec: the planner arm with no flags (Snapshot for disk, Scratch for none), both rows unconfined with the right cells, web unmeasured, the any-flag guard in KimiConsultant, the vectors, the hand-written Runtimes list and the regenerated table; all 12 scenarios are present and green, and the build, format and generator checks pass. The findings are all minor: a few weak or missing assertions, a duplicated test helper, a style mismatch in the planner arm, and plan deviations that are partly stale or describe the code inexactly.
